disposition_reason: Review of phytoremediation of contaminated tropical soils; states that some Latin American and Caribbean countries have worrying Cd levels in cocoa beans and that Heliconia psittacorum has been used to remediate Cd-contaminated cocoa soils in Colombia (root Cd accumulation). No cocoa bean or product concentrations reported.
disposition_locator: PDF p.12, Section on Heliconiaceae/Poaceae phytoremediation candidates (refs [14],[187],[188],[189]); reference list PDF pp.17, 23

study.material_scope: cocoa soils in Latin America named as a phytoremediation application

controls.control: Phytoremediation of Cd-contaminated cocoa soils with Heliconia psittacorum (root Cd accumulation)
controls.outcome: no quantitative outcome reported in this review

unresolved: Scale of the Heliconia cocoa-soil work and any effect on bean Cd are not given; underlying refs [14],[187] would need to be read.
